idle.use: stable / customise / fight idle. Per-weapon guard.

victory.use: result overlay, own bot. v003.1: weapon arm raised overhead-forward, weapon high and diagonal, chest open, chin up, rear fist pumped up-back (V silhouette). Uses the stage margin above the rig frame.

defeat.use: result overlay / KO hold. Both knees down, slumped, head hanging, weapon grounded. v003.1: both knees AND both toe caps touch ground_y (toes tucked), no floating knees, boots no longer read as slabs.

portrait.use: ranking head-and-shoulders portrait source pose. Per weapon: render it WITH the bot's own equipped weapon and own paint (see portrait.rule).

pose_format.rot: degrees ADDED to the part's default `angle`, rotating around its own pivot. Missing part = 0. torso.rot is the root rotation.
pose_format.weapon: never posed directly; it follows hand_r via grips.main.attach_angle
pose_format.blend: linear interpolation of root.x/y and each rot is valid between any two entries of the same weapon (rots are stored nearest the weapon's idle value, so no joint spins). For A2 playback use clips (every frame baked, off hand exact on every frame); key-to-key blending is only a fallback.
pose_format.aliases: pose_aliases maps v002/F7 motionPose names to A2 names; the alias entries are also present in poses with identical numbers.

face.use: QA only: visor+brow area in head-tile px. v003.2: no weapon pixel and no smear pixel may enter it on ANY clip frame (and in windup); checked by validate_kit_v0032.py.

timing.how_to_play: A sequence is a list of segments. Segment k blends from the previous pose to "to" over "frames" frames using "ease" (linear | ease-in | ease-out | ease-in-out; "hold" and "hit-stop" keep the pose frozen). Hit-stop freezes BOTH bots for hit_stop_frames on contact; skip the hit-stop segment on a miss. reducedMotion: skip walk_in bob, snap between keys, keep hit-stop at 0 frames, still show result plates.

walk.desc: in-place loop, 8 keys (contact/down/passing/up x 2). Last frame flows into frame 0. Move the bot by speed_px_per_frame (toward the opponent) while it plays so the planted foot does not skate.

attack.desc: idle -> anticipation -> windup -> strike (contact + hit-stop) -> follow-through -> overshoot -> settle -> idle. Starts and ends on the exact idle pose.

dodge.desc: idle -> dip -> dodge -> hold -> rise -> idle. Starts and ends on the exact idle pose.

hit_react.desc: idle -> hit_react (contact) -> hold -> recover -> idle. Starts and ends on the exact idle pose.

knockout.desc: idle -> impact (contact + hit-stop) -> stagger back -> reel -> knees buckle -> hit the floor -> small bounce -> settle. LAST FRAME == poses.defeat exactly.

defeat_sparks.orientation: screen-up (position follows the socket; do not inherit torso rotation)
defeat_sparks.playback: optional one-shot on KO hold; frames 00-02 then hide; static frame 01 for reduced motion or skip

portrait.rule: Each bot's portrait is rendered from THAT bot's own loadout: its paintId (paint_tokens[paintId], or the paint's hex composited material_under + tinted paint_mask + material_over) and its weaponId (pose poses.portrait[weaponId], drawing weapons[weaponId].asset with the normal grip/z rules). Never reuse or recolour the shipped sample PNGs; they are references for QA only. Re-render whenever paintId or weaponId changes (cache key: kit version + paintId/hex + weaponId + size).
portrait.facing: right (canonical); mirror only if the row layout requires it
portrait.filter: render the full 640 assembly at >= 2x parts, then crop and Lanczos-downsample
portrait.note: crop is anchored to the world position of torso.neck in the portrait pose, so any future head/torso part or paint keeps the framing

loadout.paint_label: Scrap Green: TEST paint, not in the catalog; proves the render is driven by the loadout, not by the two sample paints

mapping.reducedMotion: snap to the target pose, no tween; result plates still shown

av_exceptions.rule: Per-part angular velocity must be <= 45 deg/frame (angle-unwrapped, short way) on every adjacent clip pair, including the walk loop seam, except (1) the named frames below and (2) any frame whose smear raster overlaps an arm part. Off-hand must stay on the haft within 1 px / 2 deg except after the knockout floor release, and except the named off_hand frames below.
